entries.title_en: Mother of a Young Daughter Alleges Misconduct at Two Havelis
entries.speaker: not stated
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker asks Vaishnavs not to question women who speak about angikar, and alleges that haveli associates and even her own guru use women.

entries.title_en: Speaker Explains Why She Still Visited the Haveli After Misconduct
entries.speaker: not stated
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker explains that after a Balak came to her house at night she stopped going upstairs in the haveli, and went on Vraj yatra only with elders who stayed with her.

entries.title_en: Speaker Recounts Alleged Angikar by Navneetlalji in Junagadh
entries.speaker: not stated
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that about 22 years ago, on Pavitra Agiyaras in Junagadh, Navneetlalji performed angikar with the speaker's friend inside the haveli.

entries.title_en: Poonamji Describes Alleged Misconduct During a Vraj Yatra
entries.speaker: Poonamji
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that on a Vraj yatra about 15 years ago a Bawashri tried to hug her, that his followers pressed her to accept, and that London devotees also take part.

entries.title_gu: કહેવાતા વૈષ્ણવો ની અંદરોઅંદર ની બીભત્સ લીલા નું વર્ણન કરતા એક જાગૃત વૈષ્ણવ બેન (સત્યતા ચકાસવી)
entries.title_en: Purvi Describes Alleged Misconduct in Her Mother's Bombay Vaishnav Satsang
entries.speaker: Purvi
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that women in her mother's Vaishnav satsang circle in Bombay engage in intimate physical conduct and claim divine encounters with Thakorji, and argues that this defames the marg.

entries.title_en: Poonamji Recounts Alleged Advances by a Babashri on Vraj Yatra
entries.speaker: Poonamji
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that during a Vraj yatra about 15 years ago Babashri tried to hug her, that she was pressed to accept, and that even London devotees take part.

entries.title_en: Vaishnav Alleges an Elder Aimed Angikar Talk at His Wife
entries.speaker: not stated
entries.summary_en: In this video, the speaker alleges that an elderly Vaishnav turned a health visit into talk of angikar aimed at the speaker's wife, and urges support for those who speak against the practice.
